name: The True Story of the Vatican Council
name_pt: A Verdadeira História do Concílio Vaticano
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: The True Story of the Vatican Council (1877): Manning's account of the Council of 1869-70: the first thought of holding it, the assembly of the bishops and the preparation, the opening and the constitution on Catholic faith, the debates on infallibility, and the definition and its consequences.
desc_pt: A Verdadeira História do Concílio Vaticano (1877): o relato de Manning sobre o Concílio de 1869-70: o primeiro pensamento de o convocar, a reunião dos bispos e a preparação, a abertura e a constituição sobre a fé católica, os debates sobre a infalibilidade, a definição e as suas consequências.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1877)
edition: The True Story of the Vatican Council (London: Burns and Oates, 1877), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The preface and the five chapters with the appendix to the third; the contents is dropped.
